scope: transport-neutral desktop core; no MCP envelopes or private Host bindings

cases.contract: An admitted Host without a Desktop grant cannot reach driver IO
Unknown targets fail before Desktop IO
A window observation must identify the requested window and receipt
Snapshot is target-bound and consumed once
Snapshot expires at 30 seconds, not after
A changed reported session invalidates a snapshot
Changing an authorized driver invalidates old snapshots
Concurrent acts cannot reuse a snapshot
Ambiguous worker outcomes are explicit and never retried
A driver cannot claim mutation verification without independent evidence
Screenshot payloads exceeding 2 MiB are rejected
Truncated inventory cannot prove exact-window wait
A completed window wait reports timeout, not success
